nsict.scope: Ship-yard uses port crane;1B yard-rail only for ICD,1C yard-road. Normal excludes hazardous/ODC; reefer handling same table but monitoring extra. Use printed size rows rather than recalculate rounded20ft amounts.

nsict.invoiceRounding: Next higher rupee on grand total of each bill, not each line.
nsict.fx: RBI or SBI rate as specified; date vessel port entry for import, container terminal arrival for export. Native normal handling table already INR.
